#include <iostream>
#include <vector>
#include <cstdint>
using namespace std;

int main() {
    int n;
    cin >> n;
    if (n > 11) {
        cout << 0 << endl;
        return 0;
    }
    vector<vector<int>> coord(n, vector<int>(5));
    vector<vector<vector<long long>>> vect(n, vector<vector<long long>>(n, vector<long long>(5)));
    vector<bool> bad(n, false);
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < 5; ++j) {
            cin >> coord[i][j];
        }
    }
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            for (int k = 0; k < 5; ++k) {
                vect[i][j][k] = coord[j][k] - coord[i][k];
            }
        }
    }
    int count = n;
    long long prod;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        for (int j = 0; j < n; ++j) {
            if (j != i) {
                for (int k = 0; k < n; ++k) {
                    if (k != j && k != i) {
                        prod = 0;
                        for (int m = 0; m < 5; ++m) {
                            prod += vect[j][i][m] * vect[k][i][m];
                        }
                        if (prod > 0 && !bad[i]) {
                            bad[i] = true;
                            --count;
                        }
                    }
                }
            }
        }
    }
    cout << count << endl;
    for (int i = 0; i < n; ++i) {
        if (!bad[i]) {
            cout << i + 1 << endl;
        }
    }
    return 0;
}
